00:00:38 Maya Chen: Prices lower than anyone else in town.
[00:00:52] Tom Okafor: The first two stores opened in Atlanta in June 1979.
[00:01:01] Tom Okafor: Almost nobody came.
[00:01:05] Maya Chen: So they stood at the door handing out one dollar bills.
